description: This file defines a JavaScript class 'Tour' implementing a guided tour feature with methods for navigation, state management, and UI rendering, including popovers and backdrops. It is part of the bootstrap-tour library, version 0.10.3.

classes.name: Tour
classes.description: A class providing functionality for creating and controlling guided tours with steps, popovers, backdrops, and navigation controls.

methods.name: addSteps
methods.description: Adds multiple steps to the tour.

methods.name: addStep
methods.description: Adds a single step to the tour.

methods.name: getStep
methods.description: Retrieves a step by index, with default properties merged.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the tour, setting up event handlers and state.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the tour, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: prev
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step.

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Jumps to a specific step index.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends the tour and cleans up.

methods.name: ended
methods.description: Checks if the tour has ended.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the tour from the beginning.

methods.name: showStep
methods.description: Displays a specific step, handling popover and backdrop.

methods.name: redraw
methods.description: Redraws the overlay element for the current step.
